clips.title: The story
paras: In frigid Growless Cave, mountain yetis roam the cavern in the Alterac Mountains. The cave also holds the Flame of Uzel, a ceremonial pyre tied to Helcular's dark necromancy.

Territorial mountain yetis roam Growless Cave in the crags above Alterac's foothills. Travelers on the treacherous slopes avoid its entrance, especially when Skhowl, a notorious yeti, prowls outside. The cave holds more than danger from the beasts. Within it stands the Flame of Uzel, an arcane brazier left by the human mage Helcular. Before his death, Helcular meant to use the pyre in a dark ritual to become a lich. Its foul warmth once drew Frostmaw, a massive predator, from the frozen wastes.
